name: Servers Direct (build-to-order AI infrastructure reseller)
vendor: Various OEMs (Supermicro-class chassis) configured to order
notes: QUOTE-ONLY FOR ACCELERATED SYSTEMS, and accelerator_ids is deliberately EMPTY - this is an honest negative. Servers Direct publishes transparent prices for BASE chassis (build-to-order towers, 1U/2U rackmounts and Xeon W workstations, listed as 'From now' discounted against a struck-through regular price), and markets itself explicitly for multi-GPU training and at-scale inference builds. But its 32-system catalogue as fetched on 2026-10-03 contained no GPU nodes and no priced accelerator SKUs; the GPU configurations are behind its 'Configure' / 'Get a Quote' path, which is where an H100/H200-class build would be priced. So the base-chassis prices it does publish must NOT be read as AI-node prices: they exclude GPUs, and for a 4- or 8-GPU node the accelerator is 80-95% of the cost. Recorded here as evidence of the reseller motion (site advertises 15% first-time-buyer discount, every system built to order and engineer-reviewed before ship) rather than as a price source. Its existence and pitch are verified from its own storefront.
